newsitem.title: USA: Shuffle Master to introduce video poker.
newsitem.headline: Shuffle Master to introduce video poker.

text.p: Shuffle Master Inc said Thursday it will introduce a new video poker game at a gaming conference October 1-3, 1996 in Las Vegas.
The game, Five Deck Frenzy, is the first produced under Shuffle Master's consulting agreement with game developer Mark Yoseloff.

Five Deck Frenzy is a video draw poker game wherein each of the five cards in the hand is dealt and/or subsequently drawn from five separate, independent decks. This provides the game with a larger number of winning combinations than standard video draw poker games. The game is suited for a wide-area progressive video format.

Five Deck Frenzy will also be added to Shuffle Master's previously announced joint marketing alliance with International Game Technology. The IGT alliance was formed a month ago to develop and market Shuffle Master's Let It Ride game in a wide area progressive video format.
Shuffle Master said it expects rollout of Five Deck Frenzy over the next six to 12 months, depending upon the timing of the necessary regulatory and jurisdictional approvals.
Shuffle Master provides products and services to the casino industry.
